phase: candidate object and independent-test plan; not frozen biological conclusion
selection_timing: Post hoc candidate from supplied review and exploratory 001C; all discovery P values exploratory

candidate.score: Arithmetic mean of log2 gene expression; post minus baseline per source-ID patient
candidate.primary_coverage_rule: All six genes required for the prespecified primary score. If unavailable, record technical non-evaluability; do not substitute genes using validation outcomes.
candidate.claim_boundary: Known mature-colonocyte-associated genes; no claim of novel state, new mechanism, direct barrier function, prediction or causality

annotation_rule: Use deposited normalized expression and GPL annotation; only unambiguous one-gene probe mappings; mean log2 probes per gene. Do not repeat log transform or normalization when already performed. Preserve ambiguity exclusions. No expression-based patient identity.

primary_validation.endpoint: Deposited week8 clinical response Yes versus No; not automatically endoscopic or histologic healing
primary_validation.treatment_dose: Factor with Placebo, IFX_5mgkg, IFX_10mgkg from source exposure/dose; if a group is absent, drop only unused level and record it
primary_validation.estimand: ResponseYes coefficient: conditional difference in paired candidate change
primary_validation.test: One prespecified two-sided OLS t test with 95% CI at alpha .05
sensitivity: HC3 standard errors and approximate residual-df t CI
IFX-only association with dose adjustment, descriptive if rank/sample constraints
primary_validation.missing_covariates: Complete case for model fields; do not impute response or unavailable baseline Mayo. Baseline Mayo is not required because absent from released metadata.
sample_rules: Exclude P13 from primary analysis because two W0 arrays are unresolved
Do not infer new pairing from expression or adjacent numeric IDs
Treat verified technical replicates only under a documented identity-based rule; new information produces an explicit sample amendment before outcome analysis
primary_validation.support_rule: The prespecified coefficient for ResponseYes is positive and its two-sided OLS P<0.05; report estimate,95%CI and exact P regardless of outcome.
primary_validation.non_evaluable_rule: If all6 candidate genes are not measured, frozen inflammation membership coverage is below80%, response is not estimable, essential covariates are missing/constant or the fixed model is rank deficient, record the primary test as non-evaluable. Do not remove substantive covariates or alter score genes to obtain significance. Dropping an unused factor level does not authorize dropping the treatment covariate.
primary_validation.robustness_reporting: OLS is primary; HC3 is sensitivity. Discordant HC3 intervals are reported as a limitation and do not trigger switching the primary method.

reference_program_rules: Use input membership_001C, no feature selection from validation. Require at least80% source gene coverage for formal secondary reference tests; report measured genes and missing genes. BH across three secondary program tests. Inflammation covariate requires at least80% of frozen Hallmark200 genes.

prior_score_limits.MARS: Only component gene-mean comparators have been computed, in two fixed membership variants; no original MARS classifier performance claim
prior_score_limits.IBrD: Only15/81 measured in discovery and author-trained PCA/SCE objects unavailable; no superiority or full IBrD incremental claim

additional_validation_roles.GSE73661: Independent treatment-context and endoscopic association support; preserve actual dosing path and visit windows
additional_validation_roles.GSE282122: UC colon single-cell source and patient-level state/composition interpretation; independent of discovery signature choice

no_tuning_after_validation: Do not change genes, weights, score direction, endpoint, main covariates or thresholds to improve held-out results. Any changed object is a new exploratory version with separate independent evidence.
allowed_publication_increment: A reproducible longitudinal association of a known mature-epithelial transcriptional candidate beyond specified measured covariates, with cross-cohort and cellular contextual support if subsequently obtained
coverage_threshold_timing: Coverage rules fixed on2026-09-10 before accessing independent validation expression; they were not tuned against held-out results.
freeze_scope: Genes,weights,score,validation endpoint/model/sample rules; not a frozen claim of discovery, mechanism or validation success.
